The authoritative machine-readable record is `RELEASE.json` in the SDK repository. This page reflects it at the pinned source revision shown in the footer of the [homepage](../index.html).

| Project version | `0.1.0`, locked by `VERSION_POLICY.md`; tag and GitHub release `v0.1.0` unchanged |
| **Current wheel: build 5** | `stokastisk-0.1.0-5-cp313-cp313-linux_x86_64.whl` |
| Size | 38,057,515 bytes |
| SHA256 | `fe80d7c36fa78cf8a26feb1e00bb5f1f006ca45a027450353603976320ae0b3e` |
| Hosted at | `https://huggingface.co/waqasm86/stokastisk/resolve/main/wheels/stokastisk-0.1.0-5-cp313-cp313-linux_x86_64.whl` |

| Withdrawn | build 3 (SHA256 `72039ca4044e48fdf5edca8051dcb48b42fe61a69e07715fa8803e029581fe12`) and build 4 (SHA256 `052156d71adc6ad9966901565f86dbded9ff41c620c782db4ff377a1a2b4f62e`); not install targets |

The **project version** never changes; the **build tag** in the file name numbers rebuilds of the same version.

## Three separate classes of evidence

| Class | What | State |
|---|---|---|
| **Build 3, Kaggle acceptance** (notebook 15, 2026-11-13) | installer 32/32, static 79/79, engine 44/44, parallel 23/23, server 21/21, summary 15/15 on acceptance wheel `b31588c9b5f0d5ae103903283c7cfc25a9d7ef6c00112c3d46bb7b9ee84b023a`; the published build-3 wheel differs from it only in `METADATA` and `RECORD` (2,580 of 2,582 members byte-identical) | **Kaggle-tested** |
| **Build 3, end-user notebooks** 16, 18, 19 (2026-11-13/14) | the published install, then inference with Qwen2.5-0.5B (TP=1), Qwen2.5-3B (TP=2, PP=2) and Qwen2.5-Coder-7B (TP=2, PP=2) | **Kaggle-tested**, only those exact models and modes |
| **Builds 4 and 5, CPU only** | independent wheel audit (21 checks), member-by-member deltas, reproducible rebuild, unit and documentation-consistency tests | **verified on CPU; not run on Kaggle** |

## What changed from build 3 to build 5

* **Build 4** corrected the compatibility *reporting* shipped in the SDK (`stokastisk.compat`: the evidence records, a new exact-model registry `MODEL_EVIDENCE`, and per-model answers from `check_model`). Of 2,582 wheel members, 2,577 are byte-identical to build 3: every `vllm/**` file, every native binary, every dependency pin.
* **Build 5** differs from build 4 in three members: `stokastisk/serving.py`, `WHEEL` and `RECORD`. Only string constants changed in `serving.py` (identical AST once strings are blanked): the `MissingDependencyError` remedy now points to the pinned install command. 2,579 of 2,582 members are byte-identical to build 4; a second build produced the same SHA256; no CUDA binary was rebuilt.

Because those audits prove the inference, server and native code unchanged, build 3's Kaggle evidence is **inherited** through build 4 for build 5. It is not a Kaggle run of build 5, and this site never presents it as one.

## Where the evidence lives

| Artifact | Location in the SDK repository |
|---|---|
| Executed notebooks and reports | `evidence/kaggle/`, indexed by `evidence/kaggle/evidence-manifest.json` |
| Build-5 audit, delta and release manifest | `evidence/release/build-5/` |
| Release identities | `RELEASE.json`, `RELEASE.md` |
| Version policy | `VERSION_POLICY.md` |

## Verify your own download

```bash
curl -L -o stokastisk.whl https://huggingface.co/waqasm86/stokastisk/resolve/main/wheels/stokastisk-0.1.0-5-cp313-cp313-linux_x86_64.whl
sha256sum stokastisk.whl   # expect fe80d7c36fa78cf8a26feb1e00bb5f1f006ca45a027450353603976320ae0b3e
```
